dct_title_s: Power Supply Assessment in Benghazi (Libya) using Night-time Light Imagery
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230912LBY, GDACS Id: 1102204** Status: Power outage observed. Further action(s): continue monitoring Compared with Derna and Al Bayda, power supply of Benghazi was less affected by the floods. No significant power outage could be observed in Benghazi. Only a few areas  east of the city of Benghazi suffered of power outage after the floods, in which the power supply has recovered to pre-floods level on 24 September 2023.
